chapters.title: PAYROLL · Financial overview
chapters.copy: See gross pay, posted employer costs, settled payments and outstanding balances at a glance.

chapters.title: Exception-led review
chapters.copy: Prioritize missing evidence and review exceptions. Approval, posting and payment remain separate.

chapters.title: Keep unresolved evidence visible
chapters.copy: Missing overtime approval? Mark Needs changes and request evidence before approving.

chapters.title: Find the employee and pay period
chapters.copy: Filter the payroll register by employee and pay period, then open the individual payslip.

chapters.title: Payslip breakdown & saved approval
chapters.copy: Check gross pay, deductions, net pay and employer costs. Add a review note and save approval.

chapters.title: Post to the demo ledger
chapters.copy: Post an approved payslip to the demo ledger, linking payroll costs and liabilities to reports.

chapters.title: Simulated settlement
chapters.copy: Create a simulated settlement and bank evidence. No real money is transferred.

chapters.title: Locate bank evidence
chapters.copy: Compare bank references, dates and amounts. The same amount alone does not confirm a match.

chapters.title: Human-confirmed bank match
chapters.copy: Check the bank evidence, record your reasoning and confirm the payment-to-statement link.

chapters.title: Journal & audit trail
chapters.copy: Inspect debit and credit entries, with an audit trail of review, posting, payment and bank checks.

chapters.title: Exportable review evidence
chapters.copy: Export the audit record to preserve work stored in this browser-only demo.

chapters.title: PAYROLL · End-to-end demo
chapters.copy: Overview → exception review → posting → simulated payment → bank review → audit export.
